mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies with a temperature of 76 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail, though note that the air quality index is currently 54.

The City of Verona has reached a major milestone with the adoption of the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range vision, developed through extensive community input and mapping exercises, will guide local growth, housing, and infrastructure over the coming decades.

We have plenty of fun on the horizon. Live music is taking place at Bailey is Run Vineyard today, followed by yoga sessions at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights are starting up again early next week.

Looking at the weekly police report, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on September 28 involving a 16-year-old operator on an eMoto who was cited for reckless driving and operating without a license.

Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the crowd-pleasing Caramel Cashew. The restaurant is currently open for business and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
